provisional_leads.location: Luanda, by the Sonangol building; CPJ places a reporter's detention at a nearby protest site in Ingombota.
provisional_leads.actors_and_action: Former employees of national oil company Sonangol protested; CPJ reports a journalist attempting to cover the action was detained.
provisional_leads.publication_date: 2026-04-17 10:36 EDT (CPJ page; UTC offset not normalized here)
provisional_leads.provenance: CPJ says the account came from reporter Hermenegildo Caculo and his lawyer; it separately says the reporter had also tried to cover the same ex-workers' protest on Apr 1.
provisional_leads.uncertainty: One accessible source in this pass; it does not independently corroborate the protest or provide participant counts/demands. Keep Apr 1 and Apr 6 as dates requiring event-level review rather than assuming they are separate or identical event records.

event_date_as_reported: 2026-06-11 through first phase reported as ongoing on 2026-06-12; return-to-work reported for 2026-06-16
provisional_leads.location: ELISAL facilities and municipal waste collection operations, Luanda.
provisional_leads.actors_and_action: ELISAL workers conducted an intermittent labor strike over wages, allowances, working conditions and related demands. On Jun 12, the union alleged police used tear gas and detained six union members; ELISAL disputed the strike's legality and said some services continued.
provisional_leads.provenance: Voz de Angola article attributes its account to Lusa and quotes a union representative plus ELISAL's communications director. Novo Jornal reports the strike and quotes company and union representatives. CIAM reports the provincial government account.
provisional_leads.uncertainty: Source accounts differ on duration: the union account on Jun 12 says seven days for the first phase; CIAM reports four days of service stoppage; Novo Jornal reports the Jun 11 start and return on Jun 16 after the first phase. Jun 12 detention/repression allegations are attributed to union sources; police did not answer Lusa's request for comment. Counts and exact event boundaries require validation.
provisional_leads.discovery_status: candidate; multi-source public reporting, not validated

planned_or_excluded_items.disposition: Do not treat as a realized May strike based on this pass. Lusa/Club of Mozambique reported the planned first phase; a May 15 report says the union accepted a government proposal and suspended it before the announced start.
planned_or_excluded_items.uncertainty: May 11 sources vary between a planned end date of May 20 and May 21. May 15 report was accessible in search results, while direct opening was blocked by a verification page. Search/open details are recorded in source ledger.

planned_or_excluded_items.disposition: Do not count as confirmed June events. The accessible page claims former Sonangol workers had returned to protest and announced dates in June, but its displayed date conflicts with the search index and the stated planned dates predate the displayed date. No corroboration was found in the targeted follow-up searches.
Excluded from protest leads: Reuters describes a papal mass and religious shrine visit, a large crowd but no protest action.

Excluded wrong event year. Searches repeatedly surfaced Angola's July 2025 fuel protests and older actions (including 2023, 2024, and 2018). HRW's World Report 2026 page expressly labels its coverage as events of 2025; page/report year is not the event year.
Excluded out of scope: search results included the City of Angola, Indiana and 2026 June strike notices for Portugal/Brazil. These are not events in Angola (the country).

search_noise_and_failures: Search engines returned many wrong-year pages on Angola's 2025 fuel protests and older protests; do not infer 2026 events from a 2026 publication date.
Some broad English queries for June returned irrelevant results due to the word June; later country-plus-ELISAL queries produced the June labor-strike leads.
Some results were for Angola, Indiana, or Portugal/Brazil labor actions; excluded as foreign-location results.
Several pages were not directly accessible (HTTP 403, robots.txt restriction, or verification interstitial); snippets are marked as such and were not silently treated as opened source text.
absence_statement: No month is declared event-free. Search coverage was bounded and noisy; missing search hits or inaccessible pages do not establish absence of protest events.
